comment: Which labels the canvas HUD draws (the game designer 2026-11-10, feat/injured-tiers-fullbody: one switch per label kind; the Training Ground gets a panel for it). Read by HudLabelRules (Source/CodexTactics/Public/UI/HudLabelRules.h) at each level start and, in dev builds, re-read within a second when this file changes. show = drawn; label = the Russian name for the panel; doc = what it is and where it is drawn. Every default is true = the HUD as it was. A missing key keeps its default (on); an unknown key is logged and ignored. Console override for the wound / critical tags: Codex.HUD.WoundTags -1 (this file) / 0 (off) / 1 (on). The whole squad plate + panel also obey CodexTactics.HUD.ShowStatus. Hostile PMC fighters have no over-head plate of their own today (only the knockdown / suppression badges, which are shared). Test CodexTactics.UI.HudLabels.DataFileMirrorsDefaults.

operative_name.label: Имя оперативника
operative_name.doc: The squad member's name at the start of his over-head plate (the leader's plate is yellow).

operative_stance.label: Стойка оперативника
operative_stance.doc: The stance word in the plate: Standing / Crouching / Prone.

frostbite_tag.label: Метка «обморожение»
frostbite_tag.doc: ' · FROSTBITTEN' in the plate while his cold survival is at frostbite.

wound_tag.label: Метка ранения
wound_tag.doc: ' · WOUNDED' (light wound, HP under 50 %) or ' · BADLY WOUNDED' (heavy wound, under 35 %) in the plate.

critical_tag.label: Метка «критическое ранение»
critical_tag.doc: ' · CRITICAL' in the plate under 20 % HP (down, crawls only).

panic_badge.label: Паника / стресс
panic_badge.doc: 'PANIC! [COWERING]' / 'PANIC! [FLEEING]', or 'STRESS: n%' from 50 % stress in combat, above the plate.

rage_badge.label: Ярость
rage_badge.doc: 'RAGE!' above the plate while he rages.

posture_letters.label: Буквы режима огня (P / D / A)
posture_letters.doc: The fire posture letter in a coloured box over each operative's head (brighter frame = selected).

knockdown_badges.label: «Сбит с ног» + полоса
knockdown_badges.doc: '[KNOCKED DOWN]' with the recovery bar over any downed character (squad, enemies, PMC).

suppression_badges.label: Подавление + полоса
suppression_badges.doc: The suppression tier badge with its level bar over any suppressed unit (squad, enemies, PMC).

recruit_prompt.label: Подсказка рекрута
recruit_prompt.doc: '[Click] Talk' / '[Click] Go and rescue' over the recruit (Susanin).

enemy_names.label: Имена врагов
enemy_names.doc: The enemy's name on the first line of its plate (Frost Hound, Brute, ...).

enemy_status.label: Статусы врагов
enemy_status.doc: BURNING / ICED / STUNNED / ARMOR- after the enemy's name.

enemy_health.label: Здоровье врагов (n/m)
enemy_health.doc: The enemy's health numbers on the second line of its plate.

enemy_armor_marker.label: Квадрат брони врага
enemy_armor_marker.doc: The small coloured square before the enemy's name: green light, yellow medium, red heavy armour.

enemy_alert_markers.label: Метки «?» / HEARS / SCENT
enemy_alert_markers.doc: Over an enemy: '?' investigating a lure, 'HEARS' (the lure preview), '~ SNIFF ?' / '~ SCENT ?' (a hound on a scent).

interactable_labels.label: Подписи объектов
interactable_labels.doc: Plates over interactables: loot crates, dropped items, barricades, turrets, tripwires, narrative elements, the generator.

gate_labels.label: Подписи ворот
gate_labels.doc: The plate over a gate / blast door.

vehicle_hull_labels.label: Корпус БТР
vehicle_hull_labels.doc: '<vehicle>: HULL n/m' over a damaged or disabled vehicle.

floating_texts.label: Всплывающие боевые тексты
floating_texts.doc: The rising, fading texts over units: damage numbers, MISS, CRIT x2, RPG!, AMBUSH!, NO LINE OF FIRE, REGROUPING, the cover entry, ...

cover_texts.label: «IN COVER» при входе в укрытие
cover_texts.doc: The floating 'IN COVER (-35% damage)' when an operative takes cover (off hides only these; floating_texts off hides all).

defense_markers.label: Щиты HOLD LINE / SUPPRESS
defense_markers.doc: The green HOLD LINE / red SUPPRESS shield markers of the defend / suppress orders, with 'xN' defenders.

hit_chance.label: Шанс попадания (пошаговый бой)
hit_chance.doc: The yellow hit chance / damage over the hovered cell in the turn-based fight.

horde_warning.label: Предупреждение «HORDE!»
horde_warning.doc: The pulsing 'HORDE! n m' banner and the frame / edge arrow towards it.

combat_mode_badge.label: Режим боя и огня (вверху)
combat_mode_badge.doc: The top-centre lines: REAL TIME / TACTICAL PAUSE / TURN-BASED with the keys, FIRE posture of the selection, turret / hull / blast door status.

squad_status_panel.label: Панель отряда (приказы / состояние)
squad_status_panel.doc: The squad panel under the objective: per operative his slot, stance, fire posture, HOLD LINE order, walking / sprinting, HP, cold, ammo, matches, grenades, deployables.
